source: Milan Ficura, Impact of size and volume on cryptocurrency momentum and reversal, 2023
hypothesis: Among point-in-time liquid Binance crypto assets, prior-close proximity to the trailing one-week high predicts positive next-week cross-sectional returns.
universe_rule: At each Monday 00:00 UTC rebalance, require 8 weeks of continuous history, then keep the top 70 percent by prior-168h mean close*volume among contemporaneously eligible assets.
portfolio: Market-neutral: long top quintile 0.5 gross and short bottom quintile 0.5 gross, equal weight within sides, hold shares until next weekly rebalance.
execution: Signal sees data only through the previous hourly bar. Rebalance at current Monday 00:00 open. No same-bar signal-price fill.
funding: not modeled; positive results remain exploratory because point-in-time funding cashflows are unavailable
success_metric: 2024-2025 net annualized Sharpe from daily marked-to-market equity
survivorship_limit: The supplied 19-symbol panel is curated and not a complete survivorship-free Binance listing history.
